Plot a classical unfolded comparison

Source: R/directional-diagnostics.R
plot_classical_comparison.Rd

Plot a classical unfolded comparison

Usage

plot_classical_comparison(data, space = c("cylindrical", "toroidal"))

Arguments

data

Data frame containing theta and either x or phi.

space

Either "cylindrical" or "toroidal".

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

Other directional diagnostics: autoplot.diagnostic_atlas_data(), diagnostic_atlas_data(), diagnostic_scenarios(), plot_diagnostic_atlas(), simulate_cyl_diagnostic(), simulate_tor_diagnostic()

Examples

dat <- simulate_cyl_diagnostic(n = 40, scenario = "smooth", seed = 1)
plot_classical_comparison(dat, "cylindrical")
